title: MooCAKECTX — Beefy Vault harvest() Flash Loan Manipulation Attack Analysis
root_cause: `harvest()` is callable by anyone (no `onlyKeeper`) and there is no same-block deposit/withdrawal guard, allowing accumulated rewards at deposit time to be over-distributed proportional to the attacker's current deposit share
steps: [1] 3 WBNB → swap to CTK → deposit into SmartChef (pre-position CTK rewards)
CTK → swap to CAKE → compound into Vault
